title: watch this if you're tired of being broke
channel: Chris Koerner on The Koerner Office Podcast
description:
Check out my newsletter at https://TKOPOD.com and join my new community at https://TKOwners.com

I sat down with Shannon Jean to talk about the real mindset shifts it takes to change your life and become an entrepreneur. We talk about the entrepreneur mindset, how to build confidence, and the truth behind why most people never start. Shannon shares motivational business stories, powerful tips for beginners, and the daily habits that helped him go from reselling online to building multiple income streams, including passive income online.

We also break down how to develop a bias for action, and why your startup mindset matters more than your business idea. If you want to start your own business, create financial freedom, or find a side hustle that actually works, this entrepreneurship podcast is for you.

Whether you're looking for business motivation, ways to make money online, or real-world advice on how to be successful, this episode delivers.

You can find Shannon on X: https://x.com/ShannonJean
And learn more at: https://shannonjean.com/

Timestamps below. Enjoy!
